items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: I didn't even know him. ... Julian De La Roque, Eddie Powers, Von Gammon...

ctx.x: I got to see his voice.

I get Mike Waller. No, I guess he's going to. No. I got to see him good. No, I didn't even know him. I don't need no place. This is Fred Lloyd-Kaner here. This is Fred Lloyd-Kaner. Jody Lane, Red Bowman, Dan and Von, Julian De La Roque, Eddie Powers, Von Gammon, a little Joe Lacken, Alto, Tony Almerico, he's a big guy star, Oscar Marco, this alto man, he's nuts now, he's a big fan of the name again. Oh, and they had a band, Eastman Pocket, and he was a group there with my old man, you know, the hell, you know.…
The bass. The bass. The bass. He was a terrific trombone player, but I never heard it except on record. He was a better bass player.
